new_findings.text: Flow Matching (FM) has emerged as a principled generative modeling framework for RL, enabling expressive multimodal policy parameterizations via deterministic probability transport using ODEs, offering reduced inference latency compared to diffusion-based policies.
new_findings.evidence: Survey paper organizes literature along two axes: target distribution (action policies, value critics, transition dynamics) and mechanism; covers offline continuous control, online fine-tuning, and foundation model alignment.

new_findings.text: Value Bonuses with Ensemble errors (VBE) introduces an exploration algorithm maintaining an ensemble of random action-value functions (RQFs), using estimation errors to design value bonuses providing first-visit optimism and deep exploration.
new_findings.evidence: Addresses limitation of prior optimistic value estimates that only increase bonuses retroactively; VBE encourages first-time state-action visits.

new_findings.text: Stochastic Reward Machines extend classical reward machines to handle noisy rewards, overcoming the idealized assumption of noise-free rewards in existing algorithms.
new_findings.evidence: Novel type of reward machines for RL problems with sparse rewards depending on complex action sequences; addresses practical limitation of noise sensitivity.

new_findings.text: Reward Models in Deep RL have received significant attention as proxies for desired objectives, guiding policy optimization to fulfill task designer intentions.
new_findings.evidence: Survey covers recent advances in reward modeling for deep RL, spanning academic and industrial interest; serves as proxy for objectives in policy optimization.
